<div class="text-large" style="font-size:32px;">Tuomo Hartonen</div>

<div class="text-large" style="font-size:24px;">
**Novel computational methods for studying the role and interactions of transcription factors in gene regulation.**

Tuomo Hartonen’s thesis stood out for its overall quality and its relevance in the field of gene regulation. The Thesis Committee believes that the work makes a significant contribution to the advancement of the field of gene regulation.

In his thesis, Tuomo develops novel computational tools and methods for analysing and modelling DNA-transcription factor binding, as well as methods for interpreting deep learning models for sequence analysis.
</div>
